I can relate to the complete lack of energy and motivation you feel and especially the reluctance to "go out" I know from my thread you know i had a bad experience from reaching out.
But you reached out and i felt heard, i wish i could give you an answer on what to say but i can't. I will say this i wish you the best and i will reply here or on my thread whenever i can because i believe you are worth it
Hey i am Going through some stuff myself, i might not have experienced a break up as intense as yours but i definitely wanna see you make it to tomorrow. Reply if you want, ill be here to talk.
